gen-gf-gugi-gf-roboto: Roboto reads open and tidy, its round letters wide-mouthed. Gugi above it is the loud one, a display face with tall lowercase and terminals cut open, no tapering anywhere.
gen-press-start-2p-noto-serif: Noto Serif brings a literary, bookish voice with a prominent x-height and a gentle thick-thin rhythm. Press Start 2P is the playful retro joker, its letters pinned far apart, while Noto Serif does the quiet storytelling.
gen-rammetto-one-fs-asap: Asap reads crisp and friendly, with c forms that curl into open arcs. Rammetto One has no hairlines at all, so its stems stay chunky, and Asap keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals.
gen-rammetto-one-fs-epilogue: Playful is the first thing Rammetto One says, with tall lowercase crowding right up to its capitals and no swelling in the outlines. Epilogue replies with curvy, wire-thin, approachable lines.
gen-rammetto-one-fs-supreme: Inviting is the mood Rammetto One sets, every stroke ending at the same measured thickness, big and friendly on top. Supreme is the one that settles into text, crisp lines whose letters stay held open instead of curling shut.
gen-rammetto-one-general-sans: General Sans fills the line with a tall x-height and smooth, unobstructed bends, pressure steady from start to finish. Rammetto One stands over it as the playful, inviting half, its tall lowercase nearly touching the capitals.
gen-rammetto-one-manrope: Approachable from the first glance, Rammetto One has lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Manrope follows with a bright gap at every curve, and its pen line holds one width from end to end.
gen-rammetto-one-switzer: Switzer brings a Swiss, wire-like tidiness, with a tall waist line and c tips that never drift together. Under Rammetto One's playful heading, a long page would read smoothly and lightly, with no fuss in the letters.
gen-rammetto-one-work-sans: Chunky, playful and plainly friendly, Rammetto One has tall lowercase that barely steps down from its capitals. Work Sans follows with a high mean line and joins as thick as strokes, so text moves along easily.
